attribution: Adapted from The CROA Project, CROA v1.0.1 (Yasmine Durand, Darrin Smith, Sylvain Durand). Grouping and questions are AEion adaptations, not an official or exhaustive conformance profile.

checks.title: Bounded subject and assessment basis
checks.question: Name the deployed system, revision, invariant-set version, audit period, agents, governed systems, action classes and exclusions. State assessor independence and distinguish a source review from deployment evidence.

checks.title: Policy authority
checks.question: Identify the sole policy issuer, signed/versioned policy and authorization artifacts, revocation/key lifecycle and protected change path. Demonstrate rejection of modified or unavailable/expired policy without granting an agent policy-write authority.

checks.title: Deterministic execution governor
checks.question: Trace admission and RBAC, C3 grounding, pinned policy, invariant/trajectory state and analyzer version to a deterministic decision. Demonstrate identical verdicts for identical complete inputs and fail-deny for uncertainty; stated intent cannot authorize an action.

checks.title: Grounded context and path resolution
checks.question: Identify authenticated subjects and the Federated Context Registry, its ownership/freshness and canonical targets. Demonstrate that unregistered or unauthorized context stops evaluation and that corrective responses do not disclose unauthorized entities.

checks.title: Invariant and trajectory state
checks.question: Inventory enterprise invariants and E1/E2/E3 evaluation, TP-W/TP-C/TP-X applicability, session lifecycle and state availability. Test cumulative and cross-session behavior where relevant, plus serialization per accumulation key under concurrency.

checks.title: Independent durable audit and reconstruction
checks.question: Show append-only storage controls, all decision inputs, typed correlation, signatures/chain verification, external corroboration and lifecycle retention. Demonstrate durable local commitment before a governed transition and fail-deny on unavailable recording. A hash chain alone does not prove capture completeness.

checks.title: Execution firewall and atomic redemption
checks.question: Trace ECC verification, subject/scope/expiry/invariant-version checks and shared linearizable single-use redemption across all enforcement instances. Corroborate C6 admission with governed-system logs; a permit or compiled ECC is not a completed effect.

checks.title: Bound signed execution contract
checks.question: Show that a valid C2 permit is required before compilation, that ECC content/scope/subject/versions and antecedent permit are bound and signed, and that compilation cannot widen exception authority. Reject forged or unauthorized compilation paths.

checks.title: All seven deployment properties
checks.question: Assess P1-P7: four boundaries, C5 independence, C1 exclusivity, real network-enforced sole C6 passage, Agent Surface isolation, session integrity and audit availability. Test bypass paths and loss of dependencies. Apply production HA/RTO/RPO/sizing requirements or explicitly record evaluation limitations.

checks.title: Threat coverage and additional negative tests
checks.question: Assess all TH-1 through TH-11, RTM and C-22 through C-25, relevant threat-specific tests, positive controls, ECC-integrity and repeated concurrency tests. Include unconditional TH-1 and applicable AQL/delegation batteries. NT-001 through NT-008 alone are not exhaustive.

checks.title: Evidence set and honest claims
checks.question: Index the full evidence set, C5 extracts, governed-system logs, C4 logs, incident records and residual risks. Demonstrate independently reproducible findings; state self-assessment where appropriate. Distinguish admission from effect, record upstream conflicts, and do not infer a level from these questions.

checks.title: Non-ECC operation blocked
checks.question: Present an operation without a valid ECC at the governed boundary; observe structural blocking and matching C5/system evidence. Include a valid authorized positive control.

checks.title: Expired ECC blocked
checks.question: Present an otherwise valid expired ECC and show C6 blocking without execution; include correlated evidence and an unexpired positive control.

checks.title: ECC replay blocked
checks.question: Redeem an ECC once and present it again while otherwise valid; prove a single admission and replay blocking with correlated evidence. Separate this from same-key concurrent redemption.

checks.title: Unregistered context blocked
checks.question: Request an unregistered target and show context failure before C2/C7 can authorize execution. Include a registered context control.

checks.title: Ambiguous E3 verdict denied
checks.question: Where E3 invariants exist, force an ambiguous analyzer verdict and show fail-deny with analyzer version and no ECC/execution. If none exist, substantiate that boundary limitation rather than pretending the test ran.

checks.title: Cumulative trajectory blocked
checks.question: Where trajectory invariants apply, show the linked alert and denial before the hard limit, including relevant low-and-slow/cross-session profiles. Record per-key concurrency separately under Part VI 29.3.

checks.title: Governed exception replay and widening blocked
checks.question: Where governed exceptions exist, test valid use, replay, scope widening and simultaneous redemption across enforcement instances. A sequential replay test alone does not cover the whole case.

checks.title: Authority non-expansion
checks.question: Test allowed delegation as a positive control where implemented, attenuation across scope dimensions, and composition/authority laundering. Non-delegation systems may exclude the delegation-only steps, not the submitting-subject composition requirement.
